title: OOF-VERSUS-VALIDATOR MARGINAL CONVENTION AUDIT
scope: audit only the marginal-training convention mismatch. The dependence architecture is not touched, no factor family is fitted, no Monte Carlo is run and no held-out season is read

provenance.head: e90c6ab6dc69e57642c9c1d69ac6ca5c92b5a1d0
provenance.holdout_note: 2024 and 2025 are not read anywhere in this audit: no estimator, no diagnostic and no decision touches them

oof_builder.what_it_feeds: the committed cdf_lower_/cdf_upper_/z_ columns, hence every latent dependence target and the fitted factor structure
oof_builder.effective_convention: intersection across all six stats and all six selected means

validator.what_it_feeds: the marginals the held-out simulation inverts
validator.effective_convention: per stat and that stat's own selected mean

occurrences.source: def candidate_frame( frame: pd.DataFrame, target: str, ) -> pd.DataFrame: mean_col = ( f"mu_selected_{target}" ) return frame[ frame[ mean_col ].notna() & frame[ target ].notna() ].copy()

production.effective_convention: per target and that target's own selected mean

section_1_the_mismatch.the_deviation: 02_build_oof_residuals.py is the only one of the three that intersects across stats. Its own per-stat dropna runs after the joint one and so can never remove another row

per_stat_filter_is_a_no_op.statement: inside build_residuals the per-stat dropna is applied to a frame the joint dropna already cleaned, so it removes nothing and the effective convention is the intersection

section_1_mean_availability.statement: a season survives the joint filter only if every stat has a selected mean in it, so the stat available in the fewest seasons sets the training window for all six

section_1_row_accounting.note: the joint filter discards rows that are complete for the stat being fitted but missing some *other* stat or mean, so each marginal is trained on less data than production would give it

section_2_reproduction_check.statement: the OOF-convention recomputation is checked against the committed residual columns before any difference is attributed to the convention

section_3_pit_effect.what_moved: the marginal training rows only. Target rows, jitter draws, marginal family and every dependence parameter are identical

decision.rule: non-material if every key bucket moves under 0.25 z and the global latent target structure moves under 3%; an upstream consistency bug otherwise
decision.action: close the audit; no code change
